assumptions: The blue block's 'long side facing you' was interpreted as the 4-unit dimension being along the x-axis, perpendicular to the viewer, to fit the 'top two squares' (z=[0,2]) constraint. This results in a blue block spanning the entire back row (x=[0,4], z=[0,2]).
The 'top left corner' of the blue block was interpreted as the far-left region (x=[0,2], z=[0,2]), and the red blocks were placed at x=0, z=0 to align with the corner of the grid cell.
